fusions.name: Dusk Shriek
fusions.desc: Shrieks an alarm call 4 tiles ahead that deals 10 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 0.8 seconds and leaves them [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sipping Tusks
fusions.desc: Bites an enemy with your tusks and deals 8 piercing damage, heals you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You hold 3 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Flitter-Step
fusions.desc: You flit 2 tiles, then your movement speed rises by 30% for 6 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Twilight Wary
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
